test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct alternative of the basis of the given statements on the drainage system of the Harappan civilisation.

**Statement I:** In most of the Harappan cities, the houses had open drainage systems outside.

**Statement II: **In the Harappan civilisation, water and garbage used to drain out from the drains located outside the houses and go into the main underground drain.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
Neither Statement I nor Statement II is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harappan cities** had a **well-planned drainage system **where the waste water ran through small streams near the house.

 
 
• Small streams were built under the streets.Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.
 
 
 
• These small drains from houses were connected to a **large underground drain.**Hence, statement 2 is correct.
